summary: C4 Therapeutics furnished a Form 8-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing a press release and corporate presentation tied to new biomarker data from its Phase 1 cemsidomide plus dexamethasone trial and a Phase 1b combination with elranatamab (ELREXFIO) in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, presented at the 23rd International Myeloma Society Annual Meeting. The filing is a Regulation FD disclosure and Other Events update, containing no transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. It is a routine clinical-data current report, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
